agency_play.build_scope: No clone path - core is proprietary frontier RL. Adjacent option: multi-agent workflow copilots assembled from public APIs (memory + planning patterns they publish) sold as knowledge-worker augmentation.
agency_play.packaging: If pursued adjacent: fixed-scope 'AI teammate' pilot (chatbot that requests/stores user info per their stated pattern), then retainer for expansions.
agency_play.pricing: Adjacent pilots $30-60k, retainer $8-15k/mo; do not price against their research.
agency_play.first_clients: Mid-market professional-services firms experimenting with AI augmentation; source via the funded-startup ecosystem, not humans& itself.
